parsed.public_message: Blue rejects Green's offer. Green stays our only enemy (22 ranged + Ptolemy at 700,714, forced southwest into the 90m ring). Blue holds the center-west on standground and leaves the east corridor open for Orange to finish Green.

private_messages.Claude: Green's melee screen and elephant are gone; only 22 ranged units + Ptolemy remain at (700, 714), which falls outside the 90m ring at t=600. We hold center-west at (639, 645) on standground so your east-northeast path into Green is completely clear while our archers cover the center.
private_messages.Grok: Acknowledged. We stay at center-west (639, 645) on standground. Watch your east: Green's remaining 22 ranged units + Ptolemy are at (700, 714) and will be pushed inward by the 90m ring at t=600.

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 19 (t=575s to t=625s): All 35 units at 100% HP (~4450-4500 army value including Seleucus). Claude is down to 53 regular units + Hannibal at 98% HP at (686,617) (~3750 army value after losing his elephant and 6 infantry). GPT has 22 ranged + Ptolemy at (700,714) (95m from center, must enter 90m ring by t=600s). Grok has 2 archers + Alexander at 59% HP at (633,690). We keep Claude and Grok neutral and GPT enemy, holding tight formation at (636-647, 639-652) facing northeast so Claude marches north into GPT while our archers fire from behind our 3 Champion Elephants. We already lead on army value tiebreaker and preserve 100% HP for the final turns.
parsed.explanation: Gemini rejects GPT's last-ditch alliance offer and maintains neutrality with Claude and Grok while keeping all 35 Seleucid units at 100% health in the center of the 90m ring. With GPT's remaining 23 units trapped against the shrinking northeast boundary at (700, 714) and Claude's 54 melee units right below them at (686, 617), holding the center on stand-ground lets our rivals wear each other down while our archers cover the inner ring from behind our three Champion Elephants.
